a bulk CSV dialog on settings/members
SCIM v2 Users endpoints under apps/web/app/api/scim authenticated by scim_token

deliverables.change: RFC 4180 CSV parser (BOM, CRLF, quoted fields; columns email, name optional, role) with row cap 500, email normalisation and dedupe, role validation against invitable roles (never owner); per-line errors.

provisionFromCsv({dryRun}): requireCan member.invite, plan per row (create/invite/skip existing/error), dry-run writes only a provisioning_run row with report, real run adds existing users via workspaces addProvisionedMember and invites new emails, seat gate, updates run counts, one audit event per run.

createScimToken (owner only, plaintext shown once, sha256 stored), listScimTokens, revokeScimToken, authenticateScimToken via app_scim_token_by_hash (rejects revoked/expired, touches lastUsedAt); audited.

SCIM v2 Users service: listScimUsers (filter userName eq, startIndex/count), createScimUser, getScimUser, patchScimUser (active, role), deleteScimUser; schema JSON mapping and SCIM error envelope; all scoped to the token's workspace.
Public entry point exporting the provisioning services and types.
Add an opt-in option on inviteMember to bypass the per-actor hourly INVITE_RATE_LIMIT for bulk callers; default behaviour unchanged.

New: addProvisionedMember (find-or-create user by email, insert active member, never owner, seat gate, idempotent) and deactivateProvisionedMember (reuses removeMember rules); also export from packages/core/src/workspaces/index.ts.
Re-export provisioned-member.ts.
Add audit actions for provisioning runs, provisioned members and scim token created/revoked.
Add the ./provisioning subpath export.
Add provisioning: audit, workspaces to CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES.
Add provisioning row to the domain table, the mermaid edges and the dependency table.

New owner-defined SECURITY DEFINER app_scim_token_by_hash(p_token_hash) plus causedeck_owner read policy on scim_token and EXECUTE grant to causedeck_app, mirroring 0081_api_keys.sql:34-46; use the next free number/timestamp if the base took it.
Journal entry for the new migration (with regenerated snapshot meta/20261025000000_snapshot.json).
Snapshot for the new migration (copy of the previous snapshot; no table change).
Register every new runtime export of @causedeck/core: SERVICE_TESTS (denies/caller-checked) with real cases, or NOT_A_SERVICE with a reason.
Real cross-tenant cases for the new provisioning and workspaces services (B on A denied or sees nothing; A unchanged).

Integration test: 100 CSV rows provision 100 members/invitations; dry-run writes nothing but the run row; invalid role and duplicate rows reported; SCIM create/get/patch/delete and token auth (revoked/expired rejected).
Add provisionMembersCsvAction (workspaceAction, zod, dryRun flag, size cap) returning the run report, and SCIM token create/revoke actions only if surfaced in the UI.
Client dialog: paste/upload CSV, dry-run report, confirm to provision; all strings from the provisioning namespace.
Render the bulk CSV dialog trigger next to invite for roles that may invite.
GET list and POST create; bearer scim_token auth, application/scim+json, 401 with SCIM error envelope on a bad token.
GET, PATCH, PUT, DELETE a user.
Static SCIM discovery document (authenticated).
Add new 'use server' actions to ACTIONS with probe inputs.
Register the provisioning namespace.
English strings for the dialog and run report.
Kannada strings (same keys).
Tamil strings (same keys).
Add provisioning to the expected namespace list.

preserve.what: inviteMember default behaviour (rate limit 20/hour per actor, seat gate, email) in packages/core/src/workspaces/invitations.ts and the existing members actions in apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/settings/members/actions.ts
RLS on scim_token and provisioning_run (schema packages/db/src/schema/enterprise.ts): the new definer function reads one row by hash only and never lists; existing policies unchanged
@causedeck/core root index exports (packages/core/src/index.ts) stay unchanged unless the new exports are registered; the new domain is a subpath export like api-keys

decisions.choice: New migration defining app_scim_token_by_hash (SECURITY DEFINER lookup by hash)
decisions.justification: SCIM requests carry only a bearer token and the workspace is unknown before it resolves; scim_token is FORCE RLS. Same pattern as app_api_key_by_hash in packages/db/migrations/0081_api_keys.sql:34-46 and authenticateApiKey packages/core/src/api-keys/index.ts:239

decisions.choice: Provisioning bypasses inviteMember's per-actor hourly cap via an opt-in option and enforces its own 500-row cap
decisions.justification: INVITE_RATE_LIMIT is 20/hour (packages/core/src/workspaces/invitations.ts:33) so 100 CSV users could never be provisioned through it unchanged

decisions.choice: provisioning domain depends only on audit and workspaces; other domains imported through index.ts
decisions.justification: docs/engineering/core-domains.md 'Adding a domain' (:246-254) and the api-keys entry (packages/config/eslint/core-domains.js:52) as precedent; new domain exposed as a subpath export, not from the root index

decisions.choice: No new workspace-package dependency in any package.json
decisions.justification: apps/web already depends on @causedeck/core and @causedeck/i18n (members page imports @causedeck/core/workspaces)
